items.coder_A: not_glioblastoma; official title names recurrent GBM, apparently a registry error
items.reason: Only the official title mentions 'Recurrent Or Progressive Glioblastoma' (and agents/TTFields not registered here); the conditions, arms and inclusion ('Histologically confirmed squamous cell carcinoma of the oropharynx that is HPV-positive') make glioblastoma patients ineligible, so GBM is not 'explicitly eligible'. No manual rule covers a title copied from another study, hence medium.

items.coder_B: not_glioblastoma; title treated as a registry error
items.reason: Same basis: every substantive field describes 'locally advanced HPV-positive oropharyngeal squamous cell carcinoma (OPSCC)'; the D27B title criterion names where GBM must appear, but here GBM is not an eligible population.

note: Excluded at S5 (not_glioblastoma). Record is internally inconsistent: the official title describes a different (recurrent GBM; NAI, PD-L1 t-haNK, bevacizumab, TTFields) study. XL may wish to check the live registry entry. Candidate fields are moot; if ever needed, nogapendekin alfa inbakicept (IL-15 superagonist) given alongside the HPV vaccine could fall under D30-R4, leaving paclitaxel as the sole candidate.
